entry.title: New: Bill 112 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Passed Second Reading
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 25-45, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2026

Increases revenues in the Federal Grants – Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act account ($1,600,000)
